CREATE PROCEDURE CDN.KOL_SprawdzTwrZasob(@Twr_Numer INT,@OpeNumer INT) AS BEGIN
SELECT Mag_Kod as [Magazyn] ,ISNULL(CDN.PobierzMagAdres(TZM_MgAId),'<N/O>') as [Polozenie] ,TZM_Ilosc as [Ilosc] ,twr_jm as [Jm] ,(case when tpa_ccknumer=twr_ccknumer then TpA_Cecha else '' end) as [Cecha] ,(case when TpA_DataW=0 then '-' else convert(nvarchar(25),dateadd(d,TpA_DataW,'18001228'),104) end) as [DataW] FROM CDN.TwrZasobyMag JOIN cdn.Twrpartie on Tzm_Tpaid = Tpa_ID JOIN cdn.twrkarty on tpa_twrnumer=twr_gidnumer JOIN CDN.Magazyny on TZM_MagNumer = Mag_GidNumer AND TZM_MagTyp = Mag_GidTyp WHERE Tpa_TwrNumer = @Twr_Numer ORDER BY Mag_Kod, Polozenie
END
